In search results, each dict likely includes a field "template_id". But here we have "reaction_id". Possibly template_id is same as reaction_id? In many datasets, template_id is the integer ID. The description says "template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash)". So likely the integer ID is the "reaction_id". We'll assume template_id = 1914385.

We need to verify that this template matches our target molecule. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching with smiles target and template_id 1914385.
